ddl.value:
(`incidents`.`status` = 'REGISTERED'
          AND `incidents`.`cancelled_at` IS NULL
          AND `incidents`.`cancelled_by` IS NULL
          AND `incidents`.`cancellation_reason` IS NULL)
        OR
        (`incidents`.`status` = 'CANCELLED'
          AND `incidents`.`cancelled_at` IS NOT NULL
          AND `incidents`.`cancelled_by` IS NOT NULL
          AND `incidents`.`cancellation_reason` IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: incidents_cancellation_fields_check

ddl.value:
(`documents`.`deleted_at` IS NULL
          AND `documents`.`deleted_by` IS NULL
          AND `documents`.`deletion_reason` IS NULL)
        OR
        (`documents`.`deleted_at` IS NOT NULL
          AND `documents`.`deleted_by` IS NOT NULL
          AND `documents`.`deletion_reason` IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: documents_deletion_fields_check
